taxonomy_note: Compatibility planning lens only, not a normative cross-domain mapping. Final root-cause taxonomy may differ or remain unassigned.
native_context: OWASP LLM05:2025; classify the actual downstream injection boundary separately

controls.boundary: LLM output consumed by interpreters and renderers — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Trace model-generated bytes into HTML, commands, SQL, paths or other interpreters, including postprocessing and validation. Identify what an attacker can influence in model input/context.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a deterministic local model-output stub containing an inert boundary marker and run it through the real consumer. Compare a normal output. Establish whether the application treats generated text as executable/authoritative syntax; separately state whether an actual model produced that text.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A dangerous output in chat is not a downstream injection if it is rendered safely or never executed. A stub proves consumer behavior, not model steering reliability.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Use typed/validated data and safe APIs at the actual interpreter boundary. Retest legitimate generated output, the original unsafe interpretation and the relevant attacker-to-output influence path.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
